name: AI Coding Summit Berlin 2026
description: GitNation conference on coding agents and AI-assisted development
note: hybrid, English; 4 Dec in Berlin + online, 7 Dec remote only; 15% off for teams of 2+
dateNote: 4 Dec on-site day, 7 Dec remote day
details:
GitNation's AI Coding Summit, Berlin edition, co-located in time with React Day Berlin. About 40 speakers, 38 talks and 4 workshops on real AI-assisted development workflows: agent debugging, MCP security, standards for agent-generated code, CI quality gates for AI code.

4 Dec is the in-person day at Kosmos Berlin (also streamed), 7 Dec is fully remote. Cheapest listed ticket: Hybrid Full Ticket 625 EUR (regular, 2nd batch); remote tickets via the GitNation Multipass.
